## Implementation notes (what landed where)

1. **`hh-hosting` (new leaf crate)** — `events` (`HostedEvent`,
   `HostedOrigin`, `Mediation`, `EventChannel`, `HostedProvenance`,
   `KNOWN_KINDS`, `validate_event`/`validate_session`,
   `ensure_terminal`), `proj` (`project` over
   `HOSTED_LOWERING` + declared observability, `lift`,
   `Projection`, `LoweringLossReport`, `LossClass`/`LossEntry`/
   `LossSeverity`), `records` (`ParticipantRecord`, `AdapterRecord`,
   `HostingExt`, `ModelIoIntercept`, `ProcessPlacement`, derived
   `version_identity`), `adapter_zero` (fixture + self-consistency).
2. **`hh-ledger::classes`** — `HOSTED_LOWERING` column on the class
   table (typed kind | passthrough | hint | none); exhaustive by
   construction; the exhaustive-sweep test refuses a missing/duplicate
   entry.
3. **`hh-registry`** — `RecordKind::{Participant,Adapter}` opaque arms
   (kind-tag gate only); `ConformanceRecord` (verdict derived via
   `observed_entry`, codec re-derives and refuses authored drift);
   `ConformanceReport.hosted_entries` gated `subject_kind=participant`
   at codec + registered-participant pin at store; stale-version
   re-check.
4. **`hh-ontology`** — `InfraErrorFamily::Participant`,
   `HostingMechanism`/`CapabilityVerdict` codecs,
   `MediationChannel`/`MediationRequirement`, `EnforcementLevel::parse`.
5. **`hh-eval`** — `MetricDeclaration::{requires_capabilities,
   requires_mediation, applicability_at}`; hosted-specific declarations
   (`hosted_observation_completeness`, `mediation_coverage`,
   `usage_report_agreement`, `conformance_drift_count`,
   `synthesized_terminal_rate`, `observed_duplicate_action_rate`,
   `observed_blast_radius` — `applies_to_classes={hosted}`, folds at
   S4.5a); `veto.permission_violation` += `mediated(effects)`;
   `veto.duplicate_effect`/`veto.audit_completeness` → native-only;
   `render_cell` calls `applicability_at`.
6. **`hh-results`/`hh-analysis`** — `Coordinates.mediation` (additive);
   projection stamps mediation from `manifest.extra["mediation"]`;
   `EvalRun.mediation` populated; native rows carry the fully-mediated
   surface.
7. **`hh-budget`** — the AC-6 executable battery over the landed
   `budget_enforcement` gate.
8. **`check-removability.sh`** — new `removability(hosting)` arm
   asserting `hosting_edges = []`.

## Evidence report

- `crates/hh-hosting` — the §6.6 schema half:
  - `events.rs` — `HostedEvent` codec preserving unknown/`_`-prefixed
    members verbatim (I-3); `validate_event` (authority ceiling I-4 —
    `authority > delegate` only on `intercept`/`environment` origins over
    closed-schema kinds; `mediated` inadmissible on participant/adapter
    claims); `validate_session` (I-1/I-2 + `ModelIoUndeclared`);
    `ensure_terminal` synthesizing unobserved terminals.
  - `proj.rs` — `project(events, observability)` driven by
    `HOSTED_LOWERING`; `model.call.*`/`model.stream.*` (incl. hint rows)
    gated on declared `model_io` with `observability-gated` loss
    declarations; `lift` restores native classes, unknown kinds →
    `lifecycle.hosted.native_record` with kind+payload preserved;
    stop-reason table (`max_tokens` → `budget_exhausted{tokens}`,
    `refusal` → `refused`, unknown →
    `infrastructure_failure{participant_unclassified}` with raw spelling).
  - `records.rs` — `ParticipantRecord` (`class=hosted` +
    non-`none` mechanism enforced; `version_identity` derived, decode
    re-derives); `AdapterRecord` (claims + debt record); `HostingExt`.
  - `adapter_zero.rs` — the deterministic intercepted fixture; declared
    observability `{events, end_state, model_io}`.
  - `tests/hosting.rs` (16): codec round-trip + extension preservation;
    authority ceiling; mediated-on-participant refusal; member minimums;
    dense-seq/opened/model-io session checks; terminal synthesis; I-5
    stamps; typed-kind + loss declarations; model-io gate; lift
    never-drops; unknown-kind native_record; stop-reason table;
    participant/adapter codecs + derived identity; adapter-zero
    self-consistency; AC-2 parity.
- `crates/hh-registry` — participant/adapter opaque arms register +
  revalidate at store (`participant_and_adapter_bodies_register_opaque`);
  hosted conformance entries gate on participant subject
  (`hosted_conformance_entries_gate_on_participant_subject`); codec-level
  gates in `tests/s212.rs`.
- `crates/hh-eval` — `hosted_applicability_mediation_and_capability_na`
  (acceptance): mediated-gated veto renders `n/a{mediation}` on an
  undeclared-channel row; capability-gated metrics render
  `n/a{capability}` when unbound; native-only vetoes `n/a{class}` on
  hosted rows — never zero, never a proxy.
- `crates/hh-budget` — AC-6: `tokens.output.visible` `unenforceable`/
  `advisory` under `matched_cap` refuses `IncommensurableMatch{
  Unenforceable}`; interception-derived `enforced` accepts.
- `crates/hh-analysis/tests/kernel.rs`,
  `crates/hh-embed/tests/conformance.rs` — `Coordinates.mediation`
  fixture updates.
